glosses: level (the physical elevation at which something is located or constructed)
level (the approximate magnitude of a property on a scale)
the degree to which something is sophisticated, dignified or intellectual (of conversations, debates, etc.)

examples.text: Das Niveau ist in diesem Jahr sehr hoch.
examples.en: The standard is very high this year.

examples.text: Ich werde mich nicht auf sein Niveau herablassen.
examples.en: I won't stoop to his level.

examples.text: Er arbeitet hart, um an das Niveau der anderen anzuschließen.
examples.en: He is working hard to catch up with the others.

examples.text: Das ist doch nicht dein Niveau, Tom.
